reason: Linked memory stage 1 (shadow curation): new linked_memory_* tables (migration 0052), a curator in the project execution worker that turns completed top-level goals into verified memory cards and typed links using the chat's own model, a low-priority curation helper process for prompt assembly/verification/embedding, a strict curation admission in the provider scheduler, revisioned /engagements/{id}/linked-memory routes, nebula-core linked-memory CLI commands, Butler actions nebula.settings.linked_memory / set_linked_memory, operator docs (docs/LINKED_MEMORY.md), settings-assistant guidance and the regenerated product knowledge index. Adds the confirmed inject stage: an in-memory card index per project, helper prefetch ranking after each saved turn, a 5 ms in-memory turn-start check that adds at most three cards as untrusted reference data, and a linked_memory record in every turn's request_snapshot (shadow records would-be cards). No UI change.
exclusions: No frontend, native or Playwright tests: no file under ui/ changes and linked memory has no operator interface; the Butler workflow registry covers UI API calls only, and linked memory adds none. Python selection covers the new feature (test_linked_memory.py, test_linked_memory_api.py), the settings-assistant action catalog, the migration head and tree hash (test_runtime_bundle.py, test_migrations.py), the provider scheduler's admission paths (test_async_queue_positions.py, test_async_admission_cleanup.py), the CLI app (test_cli.py), and product knowledge freshness plus the searches near the edited guidance. tests/v3/test_product_knowledge.py::test_product_search_finds_headless_core_and_paired_butler_cli is excluded because it fails on pristine origin/main (685df5c) without this change. The real worker-process kernel test is selected because an unregistered diagnostics feature once stopped every project worker at startup; the execution-guard and Postgres worker path is validated on the fake-data staging Core with the local vLLM provider, recorded in the PR. chat.py changes only add the entry-card hook beside project knowledge and the prefetch call in _schedule_precompaction, so test_precompaction.py and the two knowledge-attachment chat tests are selected rather than the whole of test_chat.py.
